connectionSpecification.description: Reads data from a Google Sheets spreadsheet

additional_spreadsheet_ids.description: IDs or URLs of more spreadsheets to read. Their streams have the spreadsheet ID as namespace.
additional_spreadsheet_ids.title: Additional Spreadsheets

batch_size.description: Number of rows to fetch per batch request (default: 10000)
batch_size.title: Batch Size

column_naming.description: legacy: the header stops at the first empty cell, and two columns whose names collide fail discover. stable: every column up to the last header cell is read, an empty header is column_<letter>, and colliding names get _<letter>.
column_naming.title: Column Naming

credentials.description: Credentials for connecting to the Google Sheets API

client_id.description: Enter your Google application's Client ID
client_id.title: Client ID

client_secret.description: Enter your Google application's Client Secret
client_secret.title: Client Secret

refresh_token.description: Enter your Google application's refresh token, authorized with the spreadsheets.readonly scope (and drive.metadata.readonly for incremental sync)
refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

service_account_info.description: The JSON key of the service account to use for authorization
service_account_info.title: Service Account Information

oneOf.description: Use Google Cloud Application Default Credentials (no extra fields needed)
oneOf.title: Application Default Credentials

credentials.title: Authentication

incremental.description: Offer incremental sync with the _spreadsheet_modified_time cursor, read from Google Drive: a sheet is read again only when its spreadsheet changed since the last sync. Needs the drive.metadata.readonly scope.
incremental.title: Incremental Sync

requests_per_minute.description: Most Sheets and Drive API requests sent per minute; the default Sheets quota is 60 read requests per minute per user.
requests_per_minute.title: Requests per Minute

spreadsheet_id.description: The ID or full URL of the Google Sheets spreadsheet
spreadsheet_id.title: Spreadsheet Link

value_render.description: formatted: every value is the string the sheet displays. unformatted: numbers and booleans keep their type, dates and times stay formatted strings.
value_render.title: Value Rendering

connectionSpecification.title: Google Sheets Source Spec
